question: Find or classify at most three actual consumer-to-caller chains that could explain ordinary AI active-combat retreat; preserve negative reachability edges.

observation.owner_scope: Ordinary war AI active-combat retreat; distinguish player command, legality, terminal cleanup and mission control.
observation.identity_lifetime: Disk-only exact EXE; no live identity or process attached.
observation.producer: Candidate upstreams of 230A010, 1873100 and full-side/owner-subset retreat consumers.
observation.caller: Bounded direct reference census; inspect actual command vtable use when relevant.
observation.consumer: 2308250 legality, 26B4710 movement apply, 2309070 full-side and 23CA360 subset retreat.
observation.cache_lifetime: Not sampled; the a01-a03 score/mode evidence is reused unchanged.
observation.expected_signal: A classified AI caller with active-combat input and issued retreat consequence, or precise negative/unknown edges.
observation.zero_sample_meaning: No policy in selected chains does not prove absence of indirect/vtable policy.
observation.stop_condition: Classify no more than three promising consumer-upstream chains; no launch, injection or old-package edits.

edges.label: Classify wrapper upstream and active input
edges.open_question: Is 230A010 used by AI choice or only presentation/legality?

edges.label: Classify movement caller and active reachability
edges.open_question: Can 1873100 issue an active-combat move and what selects its destination?

edges.label: Classify full-side and subset consumers' direct callers
edges.open_question: Is an independent AI policy present among direct callers, distinct from defeat/cleanup and move apply?

cases.question: Observe an attributable ordinary AI active-retreat decision and outcome.
